zh: 移动端更新至 v1.1.0 (2)，并在登录后侧边栏 Dragon Claw 标题右侧同步显示当前版本号。
精简实时语音对话状态文案（去除冗长停顿提示），优化后端语音模式提示词，回复更干练、直接、响应更快。
iOS 与 Android 实时语音右上角支持「免提 → 听筒/耳机 → 静音」三态无缝切换并实时切换硬件声道，同步修复 Android 语音页面底部按钮裁切与图标居中问题。
侧边栏「告警中心未读」横幅支持点击展开原生告警抽屉，支持筛选、详情查看、标为已读与归档，关闭后精确保留在原侧栏位置。
en: Bump mobile apps to v1.1.0 (2) and display the live version badge right beside Dragon Claw in the signed-in sidebar header.
Clean up live voice conversation overlays by removing verbose pause hints and tuning backend voice-mode prompts for concise, fast, direct answers.
Add 3-mode live audio routing (Speaker -> Earpiece/Headset -> Muted) on both iOS and Android, and fix Android voice button centering and bottom bar inset clearance.
Make the sidebar Alert Center banner interactive on mobile with filterable alert cards, mark-read and archive actions, returning cleanly to the exact sidebar state on close.
